items.title: Romania shoots down drone that breached its airspace
items.summary: Investing.com -- A Spanish F/A-18 fighter jet operating under NATO’s air-policing mission shot down a drone that entered Romanian airspace without authorisation early on Sunday, Reuters reported, citing Romania’s defence ministry.

items.title: Fires erupt across Kyiv after Russian missile strike, one injured
items.summary: Investing.com -- Russian forces launched a missile attack on Kyiv early on Sunday, causing fires in at least two districts and injuring one person, Ukrainian officials said.

items.title: Iran war commander visits USS Abraham Lincoln as carrier prepares to return home
items.summary: Investing.com -- The US admiral overseeing the war with Iran visited the USS Abraham Lincoln on Saturday as the aircraft carrier prepared to return home following a nine-month deployment, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: Putin says Russia, North Korea coordinating on regional security
items.summary: Investing.com -- Russian President Vladimir Putin told North Korean leader Kim Jong Un that Moscow and Pyongyang were actively cooperating across all areas and coordinating efforts to support regional security and stability, state media reported on Saturday.

items.title: Rocket Lab, Amazon Win Space Force Contracts. SpaceX Closes Cursor Deal.
items.summary: Space Force taps Rocket Lab, Amazon, Lockheed Martin and more for communications contracts. SpaceX closes $60 billion Cursor deal.

items.title: Can Kratos Defense's $15B Opportunity Pipeline Sustain Growth Momentum?
items.summary: KTOS' $15B pipeline and rising defense demand could fuel growth as new awards expand backlog and revenues.

items.title: Is RTX Strengthening Its Position in the Global Missile Market?
items.summary: RTX is expanding missile production and investing in advanced defense technologies as U.S. and allied demand for precision weapons grows.

items.title: Is NOC Expanding Its Joint Domain Command and Control Presence?
items.summary: Northrop Grumman is expanding its JADC2 presence with secure communications, networking and battle management technologies supporting multi-domain operations.
